title: Preserve the author’s voice
rule: Keep the author’s voice while making the requested edits.
example: Keep “I built this to make mornings easier” while correcting an unclear reference.
counterexample: Replace it with “We are delighted to empower productive daily workflows.”
rationale: Editing should preserve the writer’s intended voice.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
